# Fetch playlist library (all pages)
page=0
page_limit=20
all_playlists=[]
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token,page_index=page,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(resp)
    print('playlist_library page',page,'count',len(resp))
    page+=1
print('total_playlists',len(all_playlists))

# Compute release year for songs in each playlist and build removal candidates (year <= 2021)
remove_map={}  # playlist_id -> list of song_ids
release_year_cache={}

def song_year(sid):
    if sid in release_year_cache:
        return release_year_cache[sid]
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd=s.get('release_date')
    y=int(rd[:4]) if rd else None
    release_year_cache[sid]=y
    return y

for pl in all_playlists:
    pid=pl['playlist_id']
    title=pl.get('title')
    song_ids=pl.get('song_ids',[])
    to_remove=[]
    years=[]
    for sid in song_ids:
        y=song_year(sid)
        years.append((sid,y))
        if y is not None and y<=2021:
            to_remove.append(sid)
    remove_map[pid]=to_remove
    print('playlist',pid,repr(title),'songs',len(song_ids),'to_remove',len(to_remove),'remove_ids',to_remove)

# Summary counts
all_to_remove=[sid for lst in remove_map.values() for sid in lst]
print('total_playlist_song_removals',len(all_to_remove))
print('unique_song_ids_to_remove',len(set(all_to_remove)))
print('unique_ids_sorted',sorted(set(all_to_remove)))

login=apis.spotify.login(username='la-mcco@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
token=login['access_token']

from collections import defaultdict

# Verify song library
page=0
page_limit=20
remaining_library=[]
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=token,page_index=page,page_limit=page_limit,query='',sort_by=None)
    if not resp:
        break
    for s in resp:
        sid=s['song_id']
        rd=s.get('release_date')
        y=int(rd[:4]) if rd else None
        if y is not None and y<=2021:
            remaining_library.append((sid,s.get('title'),y))
    page+=1
print('remaining_library_count',len(remaining_library))
print('remaining_library',remaining_library)

# Verify playlists
page=0
page_limit=20
remaining_in_playlists=[]
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token,page_index=page,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    for pl in resp:
        pid=pl['playlist_id']
        for sid in pl.get('song_ids',[]):
            s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
            rd=s.get('release_date')
            y=int(rd[:4]) if rd else None
            if y is not None and y<=2021:
                remaining_in_playlists.append((pid,pl.get('title'),sid,s.get('title'),y))
    page+=1
print('remaining_in_playlists_count',len(remaining_in_playlists))
print('remaining_in_playlists_sample',remaining_in_playlists[:20])
